newsitem.title: ROMANIA: ROMANIA '97 JOBLESS RATE SEEN AT 10.3 PCT-OFFICIAL.
newsitem.headline: ROMANIA '97 JOBLESS RATE SEEN AT 10.3 PCT-OFFICIAL.

text.p: Romania's unemployment rate is expected to soar to 10.3 percent this year from 6.1 percent at end-1996 as the country implements plans to restructure its communist-era industries, the government said on Monday.

The new centrist coalition government, which ousted leftists in last November's elections, also forecast a fall in the jobless rate to 10 percent next year, 9.6 percent in 1999 and 8.7 percent in 2000.
"Unemployment is influenced by the speed of reforms," said a document worked out by the government's Economic Reform Council outlining the country's main indicators till 2000.
It said structural reforms this year would inevitably generate lay-offs for which the cabinet had prepared social security measures, including compensation after closing down loss-making companies.
"We estimate faster privatisation and restructuring... will reduce unemployment to 8.7 percent by 2000," the document said.
Latest data show the jobless rate stood at 7.0 percent in April, when Romania's workforce was 10.491 million. -- Mirela Eremia, Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
